legalIntro: FiscorAI is operated by FiscorAI, a Spanish company building VAT reporting tooling for Amazon EU sellers.
legalNote: This text is for soft launch and has not been reviewed by counsel. Before full production, have a lawyer update it for your jurisdiction and company details.
privacyPoints: We collect account data needed to run the service: email, username, password hash, optional VAT number, and optional Amazon MWS token.
Uploaded Amazon VAT CSV files are processed server-side to produce reports. Processed outputs and activity needed for the product may be retained while your account is active.
Payment data is handled by Lemon Squeezy (Merchant of Record). We store Lemon customer and payment references (not full card numbers) to activate plans and show invoices.
The AI Analyst feature may send relevant VAT summary context to Google Gemini to answer your questions. Do not paste secrets into Analyst chats.
Invoices and billing records may be retained for up to 7 years where required for tax and accountancy rules.
You may request deletion of your account and personal data. Contact support@fiscor.ai; we aim to complete erasure within 30 days except where law requires retention.
We do not sell personal data. Processors today include Lemon Squeezy (payments) and Google (Gemini) under their respective terms.
termsPoints: FiscorAI provides VAT analysis tooling for Amazon EU sellers. Output is informational and not tax, legal, or accounting advice. Always verify figures with your advisor.
Plans: Free (limited), Basic, Standard, and Pro. Paid access is a monthly Lemon Squeezy subscription that renews until you cancel.
You are responsible for your account credentials and any Amazon tokens you connect. Do not share login details.
You may cancel a paid plan from Billing; canceling keeps access until the end of the paid period, then moves you to Free. Unused time is generally not refunded automatically — see the Refund policy.
We may suspend or terminate accounts that abuse the service, reverse-engineer it, or violate applicable law.
The service is provided as-is. To the extent permitted by Spanish and EU law, liability for calculation errors or downtime is limited.
These terms are governed by the laws of Spain. Courts of Madrid have jurisdiction, without prejudice to mandatory consumer protections.
refundPoints: Paid plans are activated via Lemon Squeezy Checkout as monthly subscriptions.
You can cancel anytime in Plans & billing. Canceling stops renewal; you keep paid features until the period ends, then move to Free. It does not automatically refund the current period.
If checkout fails or you abandon Lemon Checkout, you are not charged. Use Billing to try again.
If you were charged in error (duplicate payment, technical fault), contact support@fiscor.ai within 14 days with your account email and invoice details.
Chargebacks and card disputes follow your payment provider’s process. We may pause the account while a dispute is open.
Free plan usage has no payment and no refunds.
cookiesPoints: We use essential storage required for the product to work: authentication tokens, language preference, session idle tracking, and similar app settings in browser storage.
These are strictly necessary for sign-in, security, and remembering your language. They are not used for advertising.
We do not currently set third-party marketing or analytics cookies. If that changes, we will update this policy and add a consent mechanism where required.
Lemon Squeezy Checkout may set its own cookies when you pay on Lemon’s hosted pages, under Lemon Squeezy’s cookie policy.
You can clear site data in your browser at any time; you will need to sign in again.

faqs.q: Do I need a credit card to start?
faqs.a: No. The Free plan needs no card and stays free — it processes up to 100 transactions per document.
Every row in the Amazon VAT Transactions Report: orders, returns, refunds, liquidations and inventory movements.

faqs.q: Monthly or quarterly limits — how do they work?
faqs.a: Limits apply per document. Basic allows 2,000 per month or 6,000 per quarter; Standard 6,000 / 18,000; Pro is unlimited. You can upload several periods as long as each document is under the cap.

faqs.q: What happens if I go over the limit?
faqs.a: The file is still processed, but only partially, and the PDF and Excel carry an ATTENTION banner. Upgrade and re-upload for a complete analysis.

faqs.q: Which file do I upload, and where do I find it?
faqs.a: Amazon Seller Central → Reports → Fulfilment by Amazon → Amazon VAT Transactions Report. CSV only, max 100 MB.
Usually under a minute. The file row shows Processing until the results are ready; the page refreshes itself.

faqs.q: What do I get out of it?
faqs.a: The online view (charts and per-country tables), a PDF summary for your accountant, and a detailed Excel broken down by tax scheme and country.

faqs.q: Re-uploading the same period — is that safe?
faqs.a: Yes. A new upload replaces the previous files for that period and the charts refresh from the new data.
Lemon Squeezy redirects you to a thank-you page while we activate your plan. Paid access renews monthly until you cancel. You can manage plans and invoices under Plans & billing.

faqs.q: My payment did not complete — was I charged?
faqs.a: If you canceled or left Lemon Checkout, you should not be charged. Return to Plans & billing to try again. If money left your account by mistake, contact support with your email and receipt.

faqs.q: How do I cancel or get a refund?
faqs.a: Cancel anytime in Plans & billing to stop renewal (you keep access until the period ends, then Free). Automatic refunds for unused days are not issued; see the Refund & cancellation policy or email support@fiscor.ai for billing errors.

faqs.q: Why don’t I see a partial-data / truncation warning?
faqs.a: Older uploads may lack processing meta until you re-upload the same Amazon VAT CSV for that period. New uploads always store truncation and row-count details.
